claims.after_note: Evidence-scope review 2026-10-15-mcr43-conflicting-contexts: Earlier studies reported no independent resistance contribution in their tested contexts, including work using the historical mcr-4.2 name later corrected to mcr-4.3. A later clinical Acinetobacter study reported contrasting functional and lipid A results. These are context-dependent, conflicting findings, not universal activity or inactivity. Retain CARD's assertion as database evidence only; no experimental protein, organism or susceptibility observation is assigned.
